correctness.rationale: In the punctured disk with pure |z|^(2beta) weight beta>-1, Laurent integrability n>=-ceil(beta) yields the kernel K(z,w)=(z conj(w))^(-m)[delta+(1-delta)z conj(w)]/[(beta+1)(1-z conj(w))²], m=ceil(beta),delta=beta-m+1∈(0,1]. Omitting harmonic log |z|² factor gives g(x)=2/(1-x)²+c/(1+cx)², c=(1-delta)/delta. Under declared Gaussian curvature K=-2g^-1[(log g)'+x(log g)''], set t=x/(1-x): exact symbolic differentiation independently confirms K=-4Q_c(t)/[2(1+(1+c)t)²+c]^3 for explicit degree-six polynomial given in RESULT.md; all positive-degree coefficients of Q_c are positive for c>=0 and constant term -(c+2)(c²-2). Therefore strictly negative curvature for c<=sqrt2 and exactly one positive-inside / negative-outside zero-circle for c>sqrt2. Taylor root gives radius ~sqrt[sqrt2/(6(1+sqrt2))](c-sqrt2)^1/2 near threshold; substituting t=c^(-2/3)y yields c^-3Q ->4y³-1, radius ~2^(-1/3)c^(-1/3) as c->infinity. Fixed nonzero point curvature ->-2, puncture-limiting curvature ->+4. All boundary statements concern limits at deleted puncture, not assigning curvature there.

value.rationale: Sign of Gaussian curvature is a natural intrinsic invariant of the existing meromorphic Bergman kernel metric. The full pure-power weight family has an unexpected positive-curvature regime despite earlier broad negative-curvature descriptions, a unique sign-changing circle, and sharp square-root birth/cubic-root shrinking laws. This is a structurally motivated full natural one-parameter classification, not a small arbitrary computation.

limitations: Only pure radial-power punctured-disk weights; not all two-parameter boundary-weighted Bergman metrics.
The puncture itself is removed; limiting curvature values at zero are not pointwise curvature there.
Curvature normalization changes magnitude but not sign or zero circles; historical priority not exhaustive.
